notes: Model frame: car front at row 0; base p3 is 4 wide x 7 long; headlights and grille face the front. The booklet builds ONE model; the minifigure (Emma) is not in the piece list and is omitted. Steps 1-6 are on page 1, steps 7-8 on page 2.

Fix: I now read a turned piece's column/row as the position of its own corner before the turn (a clockwise 90 degree turn then reaches towards the front). So the side bricks p12/p13 (1x3, turn 90) are placed at row 5 so they cover rows 2-5 beside the seat, no longer overlapping the front mudguard p16. Plates p6/p7 and clip plates p14/p15 sit on top of them and are placed relative to the base p3. p14 (turn 270, left side) is placed at column 1, row 4 so its stud is over the left brick's third stud; p15 (turn 90) is on the right brick. Their clips point outwards.
The windscreen p2 rests on the lavender plate p8 on the mudguard and on the two clip plates p14/p15 (top at the same height).
Seat tiles p9/p10 are placed on the base studs (layer 2) rather than inside the base rim. I cannot tell from the booklet whether they sit on the recess floor, so this is an assumption.

Tyres p19-p22 are stretched around wheels p25-p28, so each tyre truly occupies the same space as its wheel. That overlap is real, so I kept it. The tyre has no ports and is connected to the wheel by that overlap and by other_joins. The wheels sit on the base side pins and overlap the base side by 0.05 stud for the same reason. Wheel height (layer -1.5) is an estimate.

Other assumptions: p4/p5 are the yellow front and grey rear plates; p24 is the pink divider behind the seat tiles; p23 arch on p5 with bracket p17 and azure panel p18 above it; p8 and the grille tile p1 are on the mudguard top studs; the pink bumper tile p11 is pushed on the front sideways (tilt 90).
Tooling note: the Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorisation in claude.ai connector settings and were not used.
